name: Visceral Magic adds 40% armor to Blood Shield (#872)
contract: Visceral Magic 707371 effect 0 is aura 107 with MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, which Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers maps to effect index 0) and BasePoints 39 + DieSides 1 = +40, over EffectSpellClassMask (268435456, 0, 0) = word 0 bit 28 = Blood Shield 504296 and no other family-26 row. Blood Shield's effect 0 is aura 142 MOD_BASE_RESISTANCE_PCT with MiscValue 1 and value 20, so it becomes 60, and Blood Shield's own tooltip reads "Increases armor contribution from items by $s1%". Tooltip: "Adds $s1% to the Armor contribution from items by Blood Shield." Regression guard for native behaviour.
